title: Is BPC-157 FDA approved?
claim: BPC-157 is FDA approved / legal to use / a safe peptide.
correct_wording: As of September 27, 2024, BPC-157 is not an FDA-approved drug, is in Category 2 of the 503A bulk list (significant safety risks), and is prohibited at all times in sport under WADA S0.
why_confusion: Online vendors and social posts often use 'peptide' and 'research use' language that collapses the distinction between an experimental substance and an approved drug.
